title: SkillContract
description: Parsed form of one pack skill (.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md) as produced by build-pack-registry.mjs. Every skill states its purpose, invocation conditions, required inputs, a deterministic numbered procedure, expected outputs, validation, evidence, failure behavior, rollback/recovery and human approval. `consumers` is derived from the agents that list the skill under Required skills; a skill without a consumer is an orphan and fails validation.
